verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts that give programmatic API access specifically for CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts, and it states that dashboards can be managed as code. That is first-party support for headless automation, but the evidence shows no CLI, no CI-specific guides, and no published API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404). Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, a documented and discoverable API reference or OpenAPI spec, CI integration examples, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users. Use them for CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, external integrations
Use them for CI/CD pipelines, automation scripts, external integrations, and any non-human system that needs to interact with the SigNoz API.
